decision.stt: Retain Whisper architecture for current 3-language evidence; first validate all 10 explicit language codes and compare against streaming sherpa/Vosk candidates before replacement.
decision.tts: Do not select a model family until each exact language artifact passes rights, provenance, Android ARM64, intelligibility, and footprint gates.
decision.lid: No separate LID model justified now. A 10-language analyzer cannot be extended from current EN/HI/TA rules; HI/MR Devanagari overlap is a hard example.
decision.priority: TTS artifact/provenance and 10-language STT validation are SIH blockers; then two-phone end-to-end timing and alert/continuous-mode work.
